algorithm: Construct a simple undirected graph from the given vertices and edges
Perform a breadth-first search (BFS) starting from `source` to compute shortest path lengths
For each node reached during BFS, record the shortest path length from `source`
Return a dictionary mapping each node to its shortest path length from `source`
constraints: Source must be a valid vertex (0<=source<n)
No cutoff is applied (as per reference brief)
Graph must be simple and undirected
edge_cases: n=1: single vertex with no edges
source is isolated (no reachable nodes except itself)
Graph is disconnected: only reachable nodes from source are included
All nodes are reachable from source
inputs: n: integer >= 1; edges: list of distinct [u,v] pairs with 0<=u<v<n; source: valid vertex (string)
output: Dictionary with string vertex keys and integer shortest-path lengths for reachable nodes only; includes source:0
purpose: Compute the shortest path lengths from `source` to all reachable nodes in a simple undirected unweighted graph
